

# Subject above: what changed, in the imperative, under about 72 characters,
# with the task number if there is one, e.g. "Lift recordings ... (T67)".
#
# Body: why, and what changed, in a few lines.
#
# Every commit carries a test plan, so whoever reads the history later can
# try the change. For a commit with nothing to try (notes, docs), one line:
#   Test plan: none, notes only.
#
# Test plan
#   What:      the behaviour being tested
#   How:       the steps, with the exact command, view or click
#   Expected:  what should be seen if it works
# Checks: the checks run and their result, e.g. npm test (404 pass),
#   npm run check-video-gamma pass
# Not covered: what no check here can see (Safari, the panel, real audio, ...)
#
# Lines starting with # are left out of the commit.
